comment: Reset must be held low for at least 200us (40000 controller cycles at 5ns)
Wait for reset release, allow some margin above 40000 minimum
CKE must stay low for 500us (100000 cycles) after reset release at ~40000
Wait for CKE assertion after 500us delay post-reset
CKE must rise at least 500us (100000 controller cycles) after reset release
Wait for MR2 load command (bank address 2), first in MRS sequence
MR2 must come at least tXPR (136 DDR cycles = 34 controller cycles) after CKE
Wait for MR3 load command (bank address 3), second in MRS sequence
MR3 must follow MR2 (JEDEC-mandated order: MR2->MR3->MR1->MR0)
Wait for MR1 load command (bank address 1), third in MRS sequence
MR1 must follow MR3 (JEDEC-mandated order: MR2->MR3->MR1->MR0)
Wait for MR0 load command (bank address 0), last in MRS sequence with DLL reset
MR0 must follow MR1 (JEDEC-mandated order: MR2->MR3->MR1->MR0)
Wait for initialization complete signal after ZQCL calibration
init_done must come at least 130 controller cycles after MR0 (covers ZQCL + tZQinit=512 DDR=128 ctrl + margin)
Initialization must complete without failure flag
